list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase and reported in the press on 18-19 Nov 2026; grades match GamesRadar+, Press Start and PC Gamer, and the hidden split (28 hidden: 27 Bronze, 1 Gold) matches the published lists. Where sources disagree, the guide for that trophy says so.

roadmap.title: Before you start: saves and the one missable
roadmap.text: GTA VI has no mission replay and 15 manual save slots (GTA Vice City Hub). Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable by any guide: Positive Mental Attitude, because one meditation spot (Lucia's balcony) is only reachable in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx / GTABase, via Output Lag). Never turn cheats on: they switch trophies off for that session, and saving too (GTA Vice City Hub).

roadmap.title: Play the story: Chapters 1-4
roadmap.text: Play through the story in order. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies unlock as you finish them; nothing here needs a special route. One quirk to know: chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene (Output Lag), so do not panic if one is late. While you play, meditate at every spot you pass, try every activity once, and grab collectibles you walk past — it saves a second sweep later.

roadmap.title: Finish the story and the strangers
roadmap.text: Finish the final mission, then finish every stranger's last mission. Eight stranger strands finished earns Strangers & Freaks. Keep a save before the final mission: the ending choice trophy (Actions Speak Louder) is tied to the choices you make.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.text: Work through the activity trophies in any order: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, beating Cal at fishing, one arcade game, 50 Challenges, hunting Bret's unique animal, and meditating at every spot. Most of these count toward the 100% checklist too, so they are not wasted effort.

roadmap.title: Crime, one-offs and money
roadmap.text: The robbery and stunt trophies: shop robberies with your partner, bank vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations for each of the 9 gangs, and the odd one-offs (airport departure, jewelry store, showroom, bowling alley, Ocean Beach cocktail). Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills and spend $100,000 across shops on the way.

roadmap.title: Collectibles, exploration and cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the collectibles: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 8 garage properties, 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros, and every one of Leonida's 52 areas explored. Then check the 100% checklist: A Long Road needs all 35 of its tasks, and the Platinum pops the moment the last other trophy does.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks automatically the moment you earn the other 54 trophies — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan on roughly 200 hours (u7buy / KeenGamer estimates) because A Long Road, the 100% completion Gold, is the real gate. Track everything in this guide's checklist and the roadmap's stage 6, and the Platinum pops on its own.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
A Long Road (100% completion) is normally the last one before this pops.
No online play is needed: all 55 trophies are single-player.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). No online trophies: GTA Vice City Hub, CryptoGames. ~200-hour estimate: u7buy, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just play the story from the start and it unlocks when the mission ends. It is a hidden trophy on PlayStation, so it stays secret in your trophy list until it pops. No preparation, no side content: follow the mission prompts.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Opening mission: GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this unlocks at the chapter's end. Chapter 1 is where the one missable warning lives: meditate at the Chapter 1 spots while you are here, because Lucia's balcony meditation spot is only reachable in this chapter (PowerPyx / GTABase, via Output Lag), and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions in order.
Before moving on, meditate at every meditation spot you found in Chapter 1.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until the chapter is done.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Missable meditation warning: PowerPyx / GTABase via Output Lag. No mission replay, 15 manual saves: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Most of the list opens up from here, because Jason and Lucia are both playable from Chapter 2 (Output Lag), so several partner trophies and activities become available. Keep meditating at new spots as you find them, and keep a manual save at the chapter's start.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions in order.
Use the new co-op partner mechanics where the story offers them.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 2.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Both protagonists playable from Chapter 2: Output Lag.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the map is wide open, so it is a good chapter to start the long grinds alongside the story: stunt attempts, races, and the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery counts all tick up while you travel between missions. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's missions in order.
Between missions, try races and activities you pass — they count toward the activity trophies.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 3.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Activity counts: GTA Vice City Hub 100% checklist (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before you push on, check the missable: have you meditated at every spot you have found so far? The Positive Mental Attitude trophy is the only one any guide flags as missable, and Chapter 1's spot is already behind you. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions in order.
Before the finale, re-check your meditation spots against the 18-spot count.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 4 and another before the final mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Missable warning: PowerPyx / GTABase via Output Lag.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and this Gold pops — one of only two Golds in the game, the other being 100% completion (A Long Road). Beebom and CULTR word the final mission as Chapter 5 (via eGamers), so this is effectively the Chapter 5 trophy. Keep a manual save before you start it: the finale is where the story's choices land, and with no mission replay a save is your only way back (GTA Vice City Hub). After the credits, the open world stays available for cleanup.
steps: Keep a manual save before starting the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.
After the credits, return to free roam for the cleanup stages.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Two Golds, final mission last: Of Zen and Computing. Manual save before the finale: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission: play it when it appears in the chapter flow and finish it. Like every named-mission trophy, it is hidden until earned and cannot be missed as long as you play the story through — the only thing that can go wrong is rushing past the chapter without a save. Nothing special to prepare.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Mission name: GTA Vice City Hub story list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission. Play it when it appears and finish it — heists in GTA games usually have a setup chain first, so work through the setups the story gives you and the trophy follows the heist itself. It is hidden until earned.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist and its setups appear.
Complete the setups, then the heist itself.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Mission name: GTA Vice City Hub story list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission. Play it when it appears in the chapter flow and finish it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Hidden until earned, like the other named-mission trophies.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Mission name: GTA Vice City Hub story list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission. Play it when it appears and finish it — the trophy is tied to the mission alone, so there is no extra objective to chase. Hidden until earned.
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Mission name: GTA Vice City Hub story list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Play it when it appears and finish it. Note the similar-sounding open-world trophy Catch Me If You Can, which is a separate stunt at the same airport — do not confuse the two; this one is the mission, that one is free-roam.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission.
Catch Me If You Can is a different trophy — see its own guide.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Mission name: GTA Vice City Hub story list; VCIA stunt trophy: Output Lag.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission. Play it when it appears and finish it; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Hidden until earned, like the other named-mission trophies.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Mission name: GTA Vice City Hub story list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list (CryptoGames) and the second Gold. 100% completion is a 35-task checklist counted by Insider Gaming: finish the story, 100 optional tasks and missions, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 smash 'n' grabs, 50 stick-ups, all 8 bank vaults, fence $100,000 of narcotics and $100,000 of jewelry, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, fence $200,000 of vehicles, 5 Kenton sets, 15 collectible card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines/books/comics, 15 meditation spots, 100 cocaine flamingos destroyed, 2 unique playlists, 70 styles, 30 unique races won, 10 race-challenge golds, 42 Shooting Range golds, 4 video games played, 5 pool opponents beaten, 2 mini-golf locations, 90 basketball hoops, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 Challenges, 15 of Bret's target decks, 200 base-model vehicles scanned, 50 standard-issue weapons and 100 animals. Note the targets are higher than the matching trophies (300 stunts vs 250 for Cunning Stunts, 70 Challenges vs 50), so the individual trophies pop first and this one last. Track it in the game's own checklist as you go — GTA Vice City Hub reproduces the full list.
steps: Open the in-game 100% checklist early and check it after every session.
Do the story, stranger strands and activities first — they feed the checklist.
Leave the pure grinds (300 stunts, 70 Challenges, 90 hoops, 100 flamingos) for the cleanup stage.
This trophy pops when the checklist hits 100%; the Platinum follows once every other trophy is earned.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 35-task checklist with targets: Insider Gaming, reproduced by GTA Vice City Hub. Hardest trophy: CryptoGames.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like, as GTA games have always counted them. The counter runs all game, so a lot of it happens naturally while you drive between missions; a fast car and the open highways of Leonida do the rest. Note that 100% completion wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 count toward A Long Road (Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub).
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and airtime whenever you travel.
Watch the stunt counter in the stats menu to track progress.
After the trophy pops at 250, keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 250 stunts, 300 for 100%: Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once — the trophy list counts 9 activity types. The activities named across the list are the Shooting Range, Top Fun drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini-golf and basketball (the 100% checklist names pool opponents, mini-golf locations and basketball hoops, and the trophy list names the rest). You only need to try each once, not win or finish it, so sample everything early: one attempt at each ticks it off.
steps: Visit the Shooting Range and fire one challenge.
Try one race, one fishing spot, one arcade game and one bowling game.
Play one frame of pool, one hole of mini-golf and one basketball hoop, and enter one Top Fun drone race.
The trophy pops once all 9 types have been tried once.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 9 activity types: PSNProfiles list. Activity names: GTA Vice City Hub 100% checklist (Insider Gaming).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 of them (PSNProfiles count, confirmed by the 100% checklist, which also wants 42 golds), so this is a grind of accuracy rather than a single hard shot: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears. The Shooting Range is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so your first visit does double duty.
steps: Find a Shooting Range and try each challenge once to learn its pattern.
Replay challenges until each shows a gold medal — 42 golds in total.
Check progress in the Shooting Range menu; the trophy pops on the 42nd gold.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 42 challenges: PSNProfiles list; 42 golds for 100%: Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are a returning GTA activity: learn each course's racing line on a practice run, then race to win — you need a win at every location, not just a finish. The 100% checklist also counts 42 drone time trials, so the drone-race skills carry over (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub).
steps: Find the Top Fun locations on the map (14 in total).
Win a drone race at each one; a practice run first helps on new courses.
Track which locations are won — the trophy pops on the 14th win.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 14 locations: PSNProfiles list. 42 drone time trials for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races are spread across Leonida in several types (street, off-road and more), so work through the map's race markers and tick each new one off as you win it. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins, so keep racing past 20 (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub).
steps: Open the map and note the race markers you have not tried.
Win a new race, then move to the next un-won one — 20 different wins.
Keep going to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 20 wins, 30 for 100%: Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival named by the trophy list; find a fishing spot, take the challenge against him, and out-fish him. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one overlap. If you lose, the challenge can be retried — it is not a one-shot attempt.
steps: Find a fishing spot and start a fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-score him in the challenge; retry if you lose.
The trophy pops when you beat him.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Fishing challenge vs Cal: GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. Arcade cabinets are scattered around Leonida's bars and arcades; pick a game you are comfortable with, play it through, and the trophy pops on completion. The 100% checklist counts 4 video games played, so try a few different cabinets while you are here (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). Arcade games are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade.
Play one game through to its end.
Try three more different games for the 100% checklist (4 played).
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 4 video games for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the strangers with a mission strand: work through his missions until his final one, then complete it. Stranger strands are found across Leonida — the map marks strangers with a question mark, as in earlier GTA games — and each strand is a short chain ending in a final mission. This trophy is one of five stranger-finale trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone); finishing all eight strands earns Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Andy's stranger marker and start his strand.
Play his missions in order until his final mission appears.
Complete Andy's final mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Stranger strands: GTA Vice City Hub; five stranger finales + 8 strands: PSNProfiles list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is one of the strangers with a mission strand: work through his missions until his final one, then complete it. Kenton also ties into the 100% checklist, which wants 5 Kenton sets collected (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub), so pick his sets up as you go. Finishing all eight stranger strands earns Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger marker and start his strand.
Collect Kenton sets as you find them (5 for the 100% checklist).
Complete Kenton's final mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 5 Kenton sets for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is one of the strangers with a mission strand: work through his missions until his final one, then complete it. His strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks, and one of five stranger finales with their own trophy.
steps: Find Billy's stranger marker and start his strand.
Play his missions in order until his final mission appears.
Complete Billy's final mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Stranger strands: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are marked on the map (the question-mark markers GTA players know), and each strand is a chain of missions for one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a finale trophy of their own, so five of your eight strands are already named for you. Start strands as you find them while playing the story, and mop up the rest in free roam after the finale.
steps: Follow stranger markers on the map and start every strand you find.
Finish the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (each has a finale trophy).
Complete any three more strands; the trophy pops on the 8th.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 8 strands, 5 named finales: PSNProfiles list; stranger markers: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is one of the strangers with a mission strand: work through his missions until his final one, then complete it. His strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks, and one of five stranger finales with their own trophy.
steps: Find Randy's stranger marker and start his strand.
Play his missions in order until his final mission appears.
Complete Randy's final mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Stranger strands: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is one of the strangers with a mission strand: work through his missions until his final one, then complete it. His strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks, and one of five stranger finales with their own trophy.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger marker and start his strand.
Play his missions in order until his final mission appears.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Stranger strands: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — the trophy list counts 18 spots. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the only trophy that may be missable, because one spot, Lucia's balcony, is only reachable in Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay (Output Lag). GTA Vice City Hub says no missable is confirmed and advises using the 15 manual save slots before big missions — so the safe play is both: meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. One honest caveat: Insider Gaming's 100% checklist lists 15 meditation spots while the trophy list counts 18, so treat the in-game tracker as the truth and keep meditating until the trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot before the chapter ends — this is the one that can be lost.
Meditate at every spot you pass for the rest of the game; do not put it off.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
If the trophy has not popped after 15 spots, keep looking: the list counts 18.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Only missable trophy, Chapter 1 balcony spot: PowerPyx / GTABase via Output Lag. 'None confirmed', 15 manual saves: GTA Vice City Hub. 18 spots vs 15 for 100%: PSNProfiles list vs Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is the hunting contact: he points you at a specific rare animal, and you have to track and take it down. Hunting in GTA VI also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 15 of Bret's target decks and 100 animals in total (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub), so the hunt is the start of a longer checklist, not a one-off. Bring a scoped weapon and approach quietly.
steps: Find Bret and take the hunt he offers.
Track the unique animal to its area.
Take it down cleanly; the trophy pops on the kill.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Bret's target decks, 100 animals for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses and out in the world — and each set is a group of cards to find. Three sets is the trophy; the 100% checklist wants 15 sets in total, so keep collecting long past this one (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). A set is complete when every card in it is found, so track sets, not just total cards.
steps: Pick up every collectible card you see while playing.
Check the collection menu to see which sets are close to complete.
Finish any 3 sets; keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 3 sets for the trophy, 15 for 100%: Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game social/photo-sharing app (the GTA VI equivalent of Snapmatic): open it at a location and share a snap to tick that location off. The same 100 locations count toward the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist are the same grind (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). Do it as you travel — stopping for a snap at every new area beats a dedicated 100-stop sweep at the end.
steps: Open WAiNK at each new location you visit and share a snap.
Watch the location counter in the app or stats menu.
The trophy pops at 100 locations; the 100% checklist wants the same 100.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). WAiNK, 100 locations for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the game's open-world challenge list (driving, combat, exploration and stunt challenges, as the trophy list's neighbours suggest). Challenges tick over naturally if you play varied: drive, fight, explore and try the activities, and check the challenge menu for the ones you are close on. The 100% checklist wants 70 Challenges, so keep going past 50 (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub).
steps: Open the Challenges menu and note which are nearly done.
Play varied: driving, combat, stunts and exploration all feed challenges.
After 50, keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 50 challenges, 70 for 100%: Insider Gaming checklist via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner (Jason or Lucia) is with you, and escape. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you — cause enough chaos together — then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. The partner requirement is the trick: this only counts when you are playing as a duo, which is possible once both protagonists are playable from Chapter 2 (Output Lag). Do it in a fast car with an escape route planned.
steps: Play with your partner beside you (available from Chapter 2).
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars together.
Break line of sight, leave the search circle, and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Partner play from Chapter 2: Output Lag.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level in between — the wanted level must stay live across all three robberies. Pick three shops close together, rob the first, drive straight to the second and third while the cops are already on you, and do not let the stars clear until the third till is empty. A fast getaway car parked outside the first shop makes the chain far easier.
steps: With your partner beside you, pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level active.
Rob the second and third back-to-back without the stars clearing.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Partner play: Output Lag.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each new vehicle type once and it counts as discovered. Leonida is full of vehicle variety, so this ticks over fast if you hop into anything new you see instead of sticking to one car. It pairs with the 100% checklist, which wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, and with On the Spot (register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app) — register the rare ones you find (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub).
steps: Get into every new vehicle type you see — cars, bikes, boats, planes.
Watch the discovery counter in the stats menu.
Register rare finds to the Scooter Bros app for On the Spot.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 200 base models scanned for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus — GTA VI's slow-motion aiming mode. The setup matters more than the aim: find a spot with 5 or more enemies grouped together (a gang shootout or a police response), trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Use a high-capacity automatic weapon and aim for the closest targets first; reloads waste the window.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus with a full magazine.
Drop 5 enemies before Combat Focus ends.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Combat Focus mechanic: KeenGamer trophy guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: steal a plane at the airport and take off without a booking (GTA Vice City Hub). Get onto the tarmac, grab a plane, and get airborne before security or the cops stop you. A small fast plane is the easiest target; expect a wanted level the moment you cross the fence.
steps: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport).
Get onto the tarmac and into a plane.
Take off — the trophy pops on your unscheduled departure.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 'Leave the airport on a flight nobody booked': GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Rhinos are GTA's tanks, and LeonidaHub counts 'taking a tank for a spin' among the six open-world secret trophies — so the method is almost certainly getting into a Rhino tank and driving it. GTA Vice City Hub still lists the exact trigger as not known yet, so treat the detail as unconfirmed: try getting a Rhino (high wanted level, military areas) and surviving a drive in it, and check the in-game hint. This guide will not invent a step the sources do not state.
steps: Raise a high wanted level or find a military area to draw out a Rhino tank.
Get into a Rhino and take it for a spin.
Check the trophy's in-game hint — the exact trigger is not yet confirmed (GTA Vice City Hub).
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Method not yet known, hint only: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store first: learn the guard patrols and camera positions, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. The 100% checklist wants $100,000 of fenced jewelry, so a clean jewelry job feeds that total too (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). If you are spotted, leave and try again.
steps: Scout the jewelry store: guards, cameras and exits.
Go in quiet, take the jewelry and leave undetected.
If spotted, abort and retry — detection voids the attempt.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). $100,000 fenced jewelry for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big planned robberies — crack the vault, grab the cash, and get clear with the cops behind you. Five vaults is the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults plus 22 bank jobs, so keep robbing after this pops (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). Plan the getaway before you go in: a fast car nearby and a route out of the search area.
steps: Find a bank vault job and plan the getaway first.
Crack the vault, take the cash and escape.
Repeat for 5 vaults (8 for the 100% checklist).
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 5 vaults, 8 for 100%, 22 bank jobs: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida: find one on the road, stop it — ram it, block it, or take out the guards — crack it open, grab the cash and lose the cops. The name is a nod to GTA V's Blitz Play heist, but the method is open-world: any armored truck counts. Bring explosives or a heavy vehicle for the stop.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and crack it open.
Take the cash and escape the wanted level.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Open-world method: GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the trophy list counts 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail into every named area on the map until the counter is full; the map itself shows which areas you have visited, so work through the blank patches systematically. This pairs naturally with the other exploration grinds: WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries and underwater discoveries (33 for the 100% checklist) all tick up while you cover the map (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub).
steps: Open the map and note the areas you have not visited.
Travel into each one — driving counts, flying is faster for the far corners.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are explored.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 52 areas: PSNProfiles list. 33 underwater discoveries for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal Operations are gang-run fronts marked around Leonida: hit one per gang — nine robberies in total, one for each gang's operation. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations robbed, so this trophy is the first third of that grind (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). Expect each gang's turf to fight back; go in armed and with a getaway ready.
steps: Find Illegal Operation markers for each gang.
Rob one operation per gang — 9 gangs, 9 robberies.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 9 gangs, 39 operations for 100%: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description reads like a plain instruction — a beachside bar on Ocean Beach, a cocktail, a view of the water — but Output Lag lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet, so no source has pinned down the exact spot or action. Go to Ocean Beach, find a beachside bar with a sea view, order a cocktail, and if it does not pop, check the trophy's in-game hint: the trigger may be a specific bar or a specific moment. This guide will not present an unconfirmed spot as fact.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a beachside bar with a view of the water and order a cocktail.
If it does not pop, check the trophy's in-game hint — the exact trigger is unconfirmed (Output Lag).
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Ocean Beach location: GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side, the classic GTA showroom escape. The description reads like a plain instruction, but Output Lag lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet, so the exact showroom or car is unconfirmed. Try a showroom display car driven through the front window, with a getaway route ready; if it does not pop, check the trophy's in-game hint.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get a car inside it.
Drive out through the showroom glass.
If it does not pop, check the trophy's in-game hint — the exact trigger is unconfirmed (Output Lag).
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Method: GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — bowl a game there. The trophy names the alley, so go to Kolt & Associates specifically, not just any bowling lane (GTA Vice City Hub notes one guide names a different alley, so trust the trophy text: Kolt & Associates). Play a full game; bowling is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling there.
The trophy pops on the follow-through — finishing the game.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Alley named Kolt & Associates; conflicting guide noted: GTA Vice City Hub.

Check the trophy's in-game hint; do not chase a guessed method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This trophy tracks the choices you make across the story — PlayStation tracks a counter up to 500 for it. Make story choices as they come and the counter climbs; it is a cumulative trophy, not a single decision, so it pops late in a thorough playthrough. Of Zen and Computing notes this trophy points to a story moment, so play the story through and it should come. Keep a manual save before the final mission, since the finale is where the biggest choices land (GTA Vice City Hub).

Keep playing — the counter climbs toward 500 across the story.
Keep a manual save before the final mission.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The description itself names the method: drive past a pedestrian and hit them with a melee weapon from the car. One caveat: Output Lag lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet, so while the description is unusually plain, no source has confirmed the exact trigger — try the plain reading first (a melee hit from a moving vehicle), and check the in-game hint if it does not pop. It pairs with Let's Go Bowling in name only; the method is a drive-by, not a bowling game.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and hit them with a melee attack from the moving vehicle.
If it does not pop, check the trophy's in-game hint — the trigger is unconfirmed (Output Lag).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies: take them to a contact who launders them into clean money, and the laundered total counts toward the $250,000. The same $250,000 is one of the 35 tasks on the 100% checklist, so it is not extra work (Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub). Robberies are the supply — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations all pay in Marked Bills.
steps: Rob banks, trucks and gang operations to earn Marked Bills.
Take the bills to a laundering contact.
Keep laundering until the clean total reaches $250,000.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). $250,000 for 100% too: Insider Gaming via GTA Vice City Hub.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything the shops of Leonida sell. The total is cumulative across every shop, so it climbs naturally as you gear up through the story; by the endgame you will be close without trying. If you are short at the end, buy an expensive vehicle or a stack of top-tier weapons — big-ticket items close the gap fast.
steps: Buy gear, clothes and vehicles as you play — every dollar counts.
Check the spending total in the stats menu.
If short late on, buy a big-ticket vehicle or weapon to finish it.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Cumulative across shops: GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the trophy list counts 8. Garages are bought from the in-game property listings; they give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Buy them as you can afford them through the story, and the last one pops the trophy. Garages also help the 100% checklist indirectly, since stored vehicles are easier to register for On the Spot.
steps: Check the property listings for garage properties.
Buy each garage as you can afford it — 8 in total.
The trophy pops on the 8th purchase.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). 8 garage properties: PSNProfiles list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle-sharing app: when you find a vehicle you like, register it to the app and it counts. Any 10 vehicles do — the rare and unusual ones you discover for Whip It Good are the natural picks. This pairs with Little Boxes: store registered vehicles in your garages so you do not lose them.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you find a vehicle you want to keep.
Register it to the app.
Repeat for 10 vehicles; the trophy pops on the 10th.
trophies.source: Official description: PSNProfiles / Exophase list via Push Square (18 Nov 2026). Scooter Bros app: GTA Vice City Hub, KeenGamer.
